00026 // VFP registers clobber list specified by intervals [s0, s31]
00027 // Header file is created by the following snippet.
00028 
00029 /*
00030 #include <iostream>
00031 
00032 int main() {
00033   int min_reg = 0;
00034   int max_reg = 31;
00035   
00036   for (int i = min_reg; i < max_reg; ++i) {
00037     for (int j = i+1; j <= max_reg; ++j) {
00038       std::cout << "#define VFP_CLOBBER_S" << i << "_"
00039       <<  "S" << j << " ";
00040       for (int k = i; k <= j; ++k) {
00041         std::cout << "\"s" << k << "\"";
00042         if (k != j) {
00043           std::cout << ", ";
00044           if (k > i && (k-i) % 8 == 0) {
00045             std::cout << " \\\n                          ";
00046           }
00047         }
00048       }
00049       
00050       std::cout << "\n";
00051     }
00052   }
00053 }
00054 */
00055
